# E62: longer training with and without realisations; more realisations (boundary TCN, GPU)

LOMO over the 8 calibration matches, trained on the configuration's sources, tested on the kinematic profile `k`. Baseline p3-refined 0.7077 / 0.6889 (8 / DFL), reproduced in this run; bar 0.7177 / 0.6939. Seeds [0, 1, 2].
